name: BP p.l.c.
research_rationale: Castrol and Aker BP divestitures reinforce deleveraging and support the hold screen; timing has cooled (RSI ~37) but transition impairments, governance and FCF definition gaps still argue against adding.

weekly_updates.summary:
3Q26 trading statement (13 Oct) guides $3.0–4.5bn post-tax transition impairments and a weaker customers & products quarter (Castrol/refining mix).  
Screen stays **hold** (5/22, RSI ~73, P/E 25.5, yield ~3.9%) after the run-up with oil; Citi and press still cite a valuation discount ahead of results.  
Net debt guidance improves to $13.5–14.5bn; no new governance RNS since Ian Tyler’s chair appointment.

Completed Castrol (65% to Stonepeak) and ~$1.06bn Aker BP stake sales (early Nov) reinforce balance-sheet repair and simplification in press coverage.  
Screen remains **hold** (5/22); timing has cooled (RSI ~37, P/E 22.4, yield ~4.5%) with filing vs TTM FCF still flagged.  
No new governance or regulatory RNS in this batch; 3Q transition impairment guidance is unchanged.
